start.tpLinkCredentials: Optional TP-Link account credentials for authenticated SMART EP10 firmware.
start.credentialsRequired: Enter complete TP-Link account credentials to pair this authenticated device.
start.credentialsComplete: Enter both the TP-Link account username and password, or clear both fields to use the global account.
start.credentialsOverrideHint: Leave both fields empty to use the configured global account. Enter a different complete account to create a device-only override.
start.ep10CredentialsOptional: TP-Link credentials are optional for TCP EP10 firmware, but required when the selected EP10 uses authenticated KLAP or AES firmware.

credentials.title: TP-Link account credentials
credentials.subtitle: Use one default account for authenticated TP-Link SMART devices. A device can keep a separate account override when needed.
credentials.replaceHint: For security, the saved password is never shown. Enter both fields to replace it.
credentials.clearConfirm: Clear the default TP-Link account? Devices using the global source will no longer have credentials until you save a new default or configure an override.
credentials.configured: A default TP-Link account is configured for {{username}}.
credentials.notConfigured: No default TP-Link account is configured.
credentials.deviceSummary: Devices: {{global}} global, {{override}} override, {{legacy}} legacy, {{unavailable}} without usable credentials.
credentials.legacyHint: Adopt only legacy devices whose complete local credentials exactly match the current default. Different local accounts remain untouched.
